overall_assessment: Extraction works well for the 21 fetched pages: complete plan text with facts box, correct year, readable structure, and the uncaptured text is only breadcrumb, responsible person and FS timestamp. The weaknesses are coverage (166 of 190 offerings return 404, one URL is malformed) and reading lists that are only a stub because the pensum is not on the page.

findings.description: Only 22 of 190 offerings have a fetched page; 166 return 404 (92 course codes, 21 of which have a page in another offering). Courses plausibly offered in 2021 (PHD610, TI201) have no page, so the older years are largely missing. Whether the 404s are genuinely absent pages or a URL pattern problem cannot be told from the packet.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: NIH's site publishes emne pages only for recent semesters (and only where the course exists); the url-based plan_years builds /studier/emner/YYYY/var|host/code.html for every offering.
findings.suggested_fix: Spot check some 404 URLs in a browser (e.g. thp311 2021, ti201 2021); if pages exist under another path or the archive (emnearkivet), adjust the URL builder in R/add_course_url.R; otherwise document the coverage limit in data notes.

findings.evidence: Fetch error: Failed to perform HTTP request. URL using bad/illegal format or missing URL [www.nih.no...
findings.description: The course code 'MAS- ESSAY' contains a space and a hyphen, producing the illegal URL 'mas- essay.html'; the fetch fails for a malformed URL rather than because no page exists.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: URL builder in R/add_course_url.R lowercases the raw code without cleaning whitespace.
findings.suggested_fix: Normalise the code in the NIH URL builder (remove spaces, check the real page slug, e.g. mas-essay) or skip codes that cannot form a valid URL.

findings.description: The Kjernelitteratur section holds only a one-line placeholder ('Pensumlista for høsten 2025.', 'Se emnearkivet'). The page text not captured lists no literature, so the actual reading list is not on the fetched page; the extraction is faithful but the reading_list section will be a stub for essentially every NIH course.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The pensum is linked or loaded from elsewhere, not inline in #vrtx-fs-emne-content.
findings.suggested_fix: Treat stub-only reading_list sections as empty in section extraction; optionally check whether the pensum link target is harvestable.
